Connector to Reconnect
Good news: Your workspace folder (The Architect) is stored locally on your computer - it is not tied to your email account. All your files, blueprints, knowledge base, and instructions survive the migration automatically. You just mount the same folder in your new Cowork session. Nothing in that folder needs to be copied or transferred.

1
Before You Start - Prep on Your Personal Account
Do these while still logged in to bakeradm6@gmail.com
Before migration
Capture current scheduled task configs
Record Knowledge Base Update Checker settings
Open Cowork, find the scheduled task, and note: the exact prompt text, the schedule (Monday 8:09 AM), and the email address it sends to. Screenshot or paste into a note - you'll need this to recreate it.
Record Skyward Friday Digest settings
Same process - note the prompt text, schedule (Friday 8:09 AM), and the full distribution email list. The distribution list likely needs to be updated to use work addresses only.
Verify workspace folder is complete
Note which skills are active in your current account
Skills are now installed via the Anthropic Skills plugin, not individual .skill files. In Phase 3, you'll reinstall the plugin in the new account. Before switching, confirm which skills are currently active so you can verify they all come back: project-tester, project-feedback, prompt-evaluator, projects-context-document-create, cowork-context-document-create, knowledge-base-context-builder, help-center-article, time-clock-diagnostics.
No files to copy - plugin reinstall handles everything. Just note what was working so you can verify it in Phase 3.
Confirm instructions files are on disk for all 4 workspaces
Check that these files exist: The Architect/instructions.md, project-blueprints/deep-research/instructions.md. The Personal Assistant instructions are in that project's settings - copy them out to a note or file if they aren't already on disk. (Prompt Maker was deprecated 2026-04-27 - absorbed into The Architect, no separate workspace to recreate.)
Note the context files each workspace needs
The Architect needs: context-agent-registry.md and context-path-reference.md. Deep Research needs: knowledge-base/index.md. These are in the workspace folder. No action needed - just confirm they exist.
Teams account setup
Confirm your work email has access to the School Tech Teams plan
Log in to claude.ai with your work email and verify it lands in the Teams workspace, not a personal free or Pro account. If the Teams plan is not yet set up, coordinate with whoever manages the account - you'll need to be added as a member.
Do not proceed until this is confirmed. Recreating workspaces in a personal account on your work email is not the same as a Teams account.
Download and install Cowork with your work email
Install the Cowork desktop app (or sign into the existing install with your work email). Cowork is a separate auth from claude.ai - make sure both are on the work account before continuing.
2
Mount the Workspace Folder
Connect your existing files to the new Cowork session
Day of migration
Open Cowork (work account) and mount The Architect folder
In Cowork, select your workspace folder - point it at the same "The Architect" folder on your PC that the personal account was using. All your files will be immediately available. No copying needed.
This is the main advantage of the folder-based system - the files live on your computer, not in Claude's cloud. Switching accounts is just remounting the same folder.
Verify the folder contents are visible
In the new session, ask Claude to list the workspace folder contents or read a known file like The Architect/instructions.md. Confirms the mount worked correctly before you proceed.
3
Install Skills
Reinstall all custom skills from the workspace folder .skill files
Day of migration
Skills are installed per Cowork instance - they don't carry over with the account. All your .skill installer files are already in the workspace folder, so this is just a reinstall from the same files.
Custom skills (from workspace folder)
Install project-tester-updated.skill
Cowork Settings → Skills/Plugins → Install from file → select project-tester-updated.skill from the workspace folder.
Install project-feedback-updated.skill
Same process. This replaces the old project-feedback.skill - do not install the non-updated version.
Install projects-context-document-create.skill
For creating Claude.ai Projects context documents. Install from workspace folder.
Install cowork-context-document-create.skill
For creating Cowork project memory files and instruction blocks. Install from workspace folder.
Install knowledge-base-context-builder.skill
Install from workspace folder.
School Tech custom skills
Install help-center-article skill
Check workspace folder for this .skill file, or check if it was already installed in Cowork's plugin library. If not present in the folder, run Skill Creator to repackage it.
Install time-clock-diagnostics skill
Same - check workspace folder or repackage via Skill Creator if needed.
Pre-installed document skills (may already be available)
Verify PPTX, DOCX, XLSX, PDF, and Schedule skills are available
These come with Cowork and may be pre-installed. Open any workspace and say "create a Word doc" - if the DOCX skill triggers, they're already there. If not, install from Cowork's built-in skill library.
Pipeline skills (from Anthropic Skills plugin)
Skills are now managed through the Anthropic Skills plugin, not individual .skill files. In the new Cowork account, install the plugin from Settings → Plugins → Anthropic Skills. This gives you access to all pipeline and School Tech-specific skills without manual file installs.
Install the Anthropic Skills plugin
Cowork Settings → Plugins → browse or search for "Anthropic Skills" → Install. This single install provides: project-tester, project-feedback, projects-context-document-create, cowork-context-document-create, knowledge-base-context-builder, prompt-evaluator, help-center-article, time-clock-diagnostics, and more.
Verify all expected skills are available after plugin install
Confirm these are listed and active: project-tester, project-feedback, knowledge-base-context-builder, projects-context-document-create, cowork-context-document-create, prompt-evaluator, help-center-article, time-clock-diagnostics. If any are missing, check for a separate plugin package or contact Adam.
4
Recreate Cowork Workspaces
Set up each workspace in the new account using instructions from disk
Day of migration
For each workspace: create a new Cowork project, paste the instructions from the file on disk into the Instructions field, then upload any context files. The instructions files are already current - you're not rewriting anything.
Adam's Personal Assistant (personal life)
Create Adam's Personal Assistant workspace in new Cowork account
Read project-blueprints/personal-assistant/instructions.md and paste into a new Cowork project Instructions field. Name it "Adam's Personal Assistant" or "Personal Assistant".
The auto-memory files (.auto-memory/) are in the workspace folder and will be readable in the new session automatically.
Upload context files to Personal Assistant
Upload from project-blueprints/personal-assistant/: style-profile.md, contacts.md, standing-context.md, keep-writing-projects.md, projects-personal.md. Also upload context-org-team.md and context-org-identity.md for personal-relevance org context (e.g., when someone from work shows up in a personal context).
Adam's Work Personal Assistant (work tasks)
Create Adam's Work Personal Assistant workspace
Read project-blueprints/work-personal-assistant/instructions.md and paste into a new Cowork project Instructions field. Name it "Adam's Work Personal Assistant".
Per the v2.0 split (2026-04-30), the original combined Personal Assistant was refactored into two focused projects - personal life and work tasks. The Work version is the replication-ready template for staff deployments per the staff-assistant-playbook.
Upload context files to Work Personal Assistant
Upload from project-blueprints/work-personal-assistant/: work-standing-context.md, context-org-team.md, context-org-identity.md. Also upload style-profile.md and contacts.md from the Personal Assistant folder - these are shared between the two assistants by design.
The Architect
Create The Architect workspace
Read The Architect/instructions.md and paste into new Cowork project Instructions field. Name the project "The Architect".
Upload context files to The Architect
Upload The Architect/context-agent-registry.md and The Architect/context-path-reference.md via the Upload button in the workspace.
Deep Research
Create Deep Research workspace
Read project-blueprints/deep-research/instructions.md and paste into new Cowork project Instructions field.
Upload context file to Deep Research
Upload knowledge-base/index.md via the Upload button.
Task Scheduler
Create Task Scheduler workspace
Read project-blueprints/task-scheduler/instructions.md and paste into a new Cowork project Instructions field. Name it "Task Scheduler". This workspace is used exclusively for creating and managing scheduled automations - all task creation goes through here.
Verify the Schedule skill is active in the Task Scheduler workspace
Ask the workspace to list available scheduled tasks. If the Schedule skill isn't triggering, confirm it was installed in Phase 3 and re-trigger from the workspace.
System Monitor (Adam-only Cowork version)
Create System Monitor workspace
Read project-blueprints/system-monitor/instructions.md (the Cowork version) and paste into a new Cowork project Instructions field. Name it "System Monitor". Two-mode tool: automated weekly health report posted to Slack, and live Navigator for AI system Q&A.
Use the Cowork instructions.md, NOT instructions-project.md. The Claude.ai Project version was superseded 2026-04-30 by AI Advisor and is not part of this migration.
Upload context files to System Monitor
Upload from project-blueprints/system-monitor/: context-health-check-rules.md, context-system-reference.md, context-maintenance-sop.md.
5
Reconnect Gmail and Recreate Scheduled Tasks
Restore connectors and background automations
Day of migration
Gmail connector
Reconnect Gmail in the new Cowork account
In Cowork connectors/plugins settings, reconnect Gmail. If your work email is Google Workspace (Gmail-based), connect with the work address instead of bakeradm6@gmail.com. If work email is not Google, this connector may not apply - check what email platform School Tech uses.
If you reconnect with your personal Gmail instead of work Gmail, the Personal Assistant will still be reading your personal inbox, not your work inbox. Confirm which account to connect.
Knowledge Base Update Checker
Recreate KB Update Checker scheduled task
Open Personal Assistant in the new account, use the Schedule skill, and recreate the task using the prompt and settings you recorded in Phase 1. Schedule: every Monday at 8:09 AM.
Update email target to work address
When recreating the task, set the email delivery target to your work email address, not bakeradm6@gmail.com.
Skyward Friday Digest
Recreate Skyward Friday Digest scheduled task
Use the Schedule skill with the prompt and settings from Phase 1. Schedule: every Friday at 8:09 AM.
Update the distribution list to use work email addresses
If the digest was being sent to any @gmail.com or personal addresses, update them to work addresses. The entire distribution should be on School Tech email.
Pause the old scheduled tasks on the personal account
Once the new tasks are running, disable or delete the tasks on bakeradm6@gmail.com to avoid duplicate digests being sent.
If you don't do this, both the personal and work accounts will run the same tasks and send duplicate emails.
6
Set Up Team Projects in Claude.ai
Create shareable Projects for team members on the Teams account
After Cowork is set up
Claude.ai Projects (shareable with team) are separate from Cowork workspaces. You create them at claude.ai, not in the Cowork app. Team members access them at claude.ai with their own accounts - they don't need Cowork. These are the projects you'll deploy to the broader School Tech team.
Current Claude.ai Project state (per context-agent-registry.md, 2026-05-01):
  • AI Advisor - Active. Live for all staff. Recreate first.
  • STA Main Chat - Draft. Build via The Architect Full Pipeline (foundation - dependency for STA Support Chat).
  • STA Support Chat - Draft. Build after STA Main Chat is live (extends it).
  • Salesforce Admin Assistant - Draft. Build via Full Pipeline. Primary users: Kelsey (Salesforce Admin / Ops Analyst), Joanie, Tanya.
  • Document Maker - Draft. Build via Full Pipeline. Independent - no dependencies.
Build order recommended in Future Enhancements/agent-rollout-sow-2026-04-28.html: STA Main Chat -> Salesforce Admin Assistant -> STA Support Chat -> Document Maker.
For each project you want to share with the team
Decide: Cowork-only, Claude.ai Project only, or both
Use the deployment decision framework: personal build tools (The Architect, Deep Research, Task Scheduler) stay Cowork-only. Team-facing tools (STA Main Chat, Support Chat, Salesforce) go to Claude.ai Projects. Hybrid tools (Help Center Article workflows) may need both.
For team-facing projects: run through the build pipeline with "Claude.ai Projects" as the target
Before deploying STA Main Chat, Support Chat, etc. to the team, build them properly through The Architect → Project Tester. The Architect handles discovery, blueprint, instructions, test cases, registry entry, and handoff in one pass. Make sure the deployment target is set to "Claude.ai Project" so the instructions are self-contained with no skill references.
Create each shared Project in claude.ai (Teams account)
Go to claude.ai → Projects → New Project. Paste instructions into the Instructions field. Upload context files via the Upload button. Name the project clearly for team members.
Share each Project with team members
In the Project settings, use the sharing/invite option to add team members by their work email. They'll be able to access the Project from their own claude.ai logins.
7
Verify Everything Works
Test each component before relying on the new account
After setup
Workspace smoke tests
Personal Assistant: ask it to rewrite a short email
Confirm it responds in the right tone. Also ask it to read a file from the workspace folder - confirms the folder is mounted and readable.
The Architect: ask it what projects are in the registry
It should read the registry context file and list existing projects. Confirms context files were uploaded correctly.
Skills: trigger one custom skill and one document skill
Say "write a KB article about X" to test Help Center Article skill. Say "make a Word doc" to test DOCX skill. Both should activate.
Scheduled tasks: verify they appear in the scheduled tasks list
Ask Claude to list scheduled tasks. Both automations should appear with correct schedules. If possible, trigger a manual run of one to confirm it executes and sends email to the right address.
Cleanup on personal account
Disable both scheduled tasks on bakeradm6@gmail.com account
Once verified running on work account. Prevents duplicate automation runs.
Stop using personal account Cowork workspaces
Once the new account is verified, use only the work account going forward. Changes made to the workspace folder from the new session will be visible to both accounts since it's the same local folder - but only one should be the primary.
Delete stale files from workspace folder (if not done yet)
While you're doing migration housekeeping: delete AI-Project-System-Overview.html, project-architect.skill, project-tester.skill, project-feedback.skill, and test_write from the workspace folder.
